Name: radsilver's Hairy Yaks
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
A continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22319]cantiblaChao's Yaks for 1.6[/url], Radicalvice wanted the yaks to match up better with siamance's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url]. So, Radicalvice did the art, and I provided the code!

Yaks will produce both milk and fiber, which can be turned into cheese and yarn, respectively. They live in barns and can be purchased ﻿at Marnie's, as usual.

Enjoy!
